seo.title: Gift — a GitHub webhook server, and the git chores around it
seo.description: Gift answers a GitHub push by running the script you named, in the folder you named. Around that server sits a set of git functions: watch every repository under one folder, pull them all, read back a week of pull requests.
seo.keywords: github webhook server, webhook listener, deploy on push, git automation, command line, self hosted
